        "scope_quotes": ["F001:F004"],
        "scope_text": "Except as provided in 49 CFR 1540.111(b), when performance has begun of the inspection of an individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under 49 CFR 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.",

        "choice_text": "One or more of: (1) when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; (2) when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or (3) when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under 49 CFR 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.",

        "references": ["paragraph (b) of this section", "§§ 1544.201", "1546.201", "1562.23"],
        "statement": "Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary on or about the individual's person or accessible property when inspection has begun before entering a sterile area or before boarding an aircraft screened under this subchapter, when entering or in a sterile area, or when attempting to board or onboard an aircraft screened under 49 CFR 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23."

        "alternative_quotes": ["F006", "F007", "F008"],
        "choice_quote": "F005:F008",
        "choice_text": "Any one of the following: (1) law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; (2) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with 49 CFR 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562; or (3) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.",

      }
    },
    {

        "kind": "prohibition",
        "scope_quotes": ["F009"],
        "scope_text": "For baggage transported or offered for transport by a passenger in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23.",

unit_attributes.scope_text: Except as provided in 49 CFR 1540.111(b), when performance has begun of the inspection of an individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under 49 CFR 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.
unit_attributes.choice_text: One or more of: (1) when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; (2) when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or (3) when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under 49 CFR 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.
unit_attributes.statement: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary on or about the individual's person or accessible property when inspection has begun before entering a sterile area or before boarding an aircraft screened under this subchapter, when entering or in a sterile area, or when attempting to board or onboard an aircraft screened under 49 CFR 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.

unit_attributes.scope_text: With respect to the carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property, where the individual is law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with 49 CFR 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562; or an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Any one of the following: (1) law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; (2) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with 49 CFR 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562; or (3) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.
unit_attributes.statement: Paragraph (a) of 49 CFR 1540.111 does not apply to the carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property if the individual is law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while performing law enforcement duty at the airport, an individual authorized to carry a weapon under 49 CFR 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562, or an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For baggage transported or offered for transport by a passenger in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23 any loaded firearm(s).

unit_attributes.scope_text: For baggage transported or offered for transport by a passenger in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23, unless: (i) the passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded; (ii) the firearm is unloaded; (iii) the firearm is carried in a hard-sided container; and (iv) the container in which it is carried is locked, and only the passenger retains the key or combination.
unit_attributes.choice_text: All of the following conditions must be satisfied: (i) the passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded; (ii) the firearm is unloaded; (iii) the firearm is carried in a hard-sided container; and (iv) the container in which it is carried is locked, and only the passenger retains the key or combination.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23 any unloaded firearm(s) unless the passenger declares the unloaded firearm to the aircraft operator orally or in writing before checking the baggage, the firearm is unloaded, the firearm is carried in a hard-sided container, and the container is locked with only the passenger retaining the key or combination.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For baggage transported or offered for transport by a passenger in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23 any unauthorized explosive or incendiary.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Under 49 CFR 1540.111, with respect to the carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.
unit_attributes.choice_text: In checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.
unit_attributes.statement: 49 CFR 1540.111 does not prohibit the carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For carriage of ammunition on aircraft.
unit_attributes.statement: Title 49 CFR part 175 provides additional requirements governing the carriage of ammunition on aircraft.
